calibration: 2026-11-24 labeled pilot: one Jev call per section with the labeled examples and these rules as state (arm C). At these thresholds it flagged every labeled defect with 0 to 25 percent false positives on clean text; two runs differ by about 0.02. Labels were thin and the thresholds were chosen on the same labels, so every hit is advisory. repetition and unexplained_term are not usable (threshold null): they stay in the bundle because the other answers were calibrated with them asked (dropping them raised contradiction from 3 to 5 hits on 12 clean sections), but they are never reported; the deterministic checks cover them. Re-score on a new labeled page before changing a threshold. ui_instruction asks about section_text (2026-11-24 re-score on the same slice: 3/3 found, 1/12 false positives on clean sections, 0/10 on other-defect sections, against 2/10 with the earlier page-wide wording, which also flagged sections next to the one with the instruction).

ui_instruction.question: Does the section_text contain an instruction on how to operate the page or a diagram itself (for example swipe, click, scroll, tap, zoom), as opposed to describing the system?
ui_instruction.rule: RULE ui_instruction: A documentation page describes the system. Instructions for operating the page or its diagrams (swipe, click, scroll, tap) are not documentation and do not belong in the text.
examples: YES: 'Tippen Sie auf einen Baustein, um die Details zu sehen.'
NO: 'Gestrichelte Pfeile zeigen optionale Verbindungen.'

repetition.question: Does a statement in the section_text repeat, almost word for word or in the same facts, a statement that also appears in other_sections?
repetition.rule: RULE repetition: Each statement has one home. The same point again in another section, in other or identical words, is restating. Compare against other_sections.
examples: YES: section says 'Sitzung 24 Stunden, Token 7 Tage.' and other_sections already say 'Sitzung 24 Stunden, Token 7 Tage.'
NO: section links to the other place: 'Die Laufzeiten stehen unter Anmeldung.'

contradiction.question: Does the section_text contain two claims that cannot both be true, or claim something that other_sections contradicts?
contradiction.rule: RULE contradiction: Two claims that cannot both hold (a figure, a date, a status, an 'excluded' versus an 'exception today') are a self-contradiction.
examples: YES: 'Externe Anbieter sind ausgeschlossen.' and, elsewhere, 'Ausnahme heute: Anbieter X.'
NO: 'Externe Anbieter sind ausgeschlossen. Anbieter X läuft heute noch und wird abgeschaltet.'

target_as_built.question: Does the section_text state in the present tense that something is done, running or available that, according to the page, is only intended, planned or still to be built?
target_as_built.rule: RULE target_as_built: Overclaiming says more than exists. A target state, a plan or a thing to be built must be written as such ('soll', 'ist geplant'), never in the present tense as done.
examples: YES: 'Der Kunde übernimmt die Konfiguration unverändert.' (not yet done, only intended)
NO: 'Der Kunde soll die Konfiguration übernehmen.'

universal_claim.question: Does the section_text make a universal claim (only, always, never, all, every, none) without naming evidence, or one that another passage on the page contradicts?
universal_claim.rule: RULE universal_claim: A claim about a system that nothing backs, in particular universal words (only, always, never, all), is an unanchored claim. It needs evidence in the text, or must be limited.
examples: YES: 'Alle Agenten nutzen nur Modell M.' while the page says the builder runs on model N
NO: 'Die Agenten der Plattform nutzen heute Modell M; der Builder läuft mit Modell N.'

unexplained_term.question: Does the section_text use an acronym, protocol name or internal name that the stated audience probably does not know and that is not explained at first use?
unexplained_term.rule: RULE unexplained_term: Every term, acronym or internal name the target group may not know is explained at first use or sits in a glossary.
examples: YES: 'Die Anmeldung nutzt PKCE und JWKS-Rotation.' for a non-specialist audience
NO: 'Die Anmeldung läuft über den Identity Provider (IdP) des Kunden.'

provoking.question: Does the section_text name an assessment label, certification, maturity level, employee-representation body or internal programme that a technical platform description for outside reviewers does not need?
provoking.rule: RULE provoking: Name only what the reader needs. Naming assessment labels, maturity models, employee-representation bodies or internal programmes that the description does not need signals insider knowledge or invites objections.
examples: YES: a table row 'Betriebsrat: noch nicht beteiligt' in a technical description
NO: 'Die Verarbeitung erfolgt in der EU.'

tell_not_x_but_y.question: Does the section_text contain a contrast of the form 'not X but Y' (nicht X, sondern Y) where X names something nobody claimed?
tell_not_x_but_y.rule: RULE tell_not_x_but_y: 'Not X but Y' (nicht X, sondern Y; not just X, but Y): the negative half names something nobody claimed so the positive half sounds larger. State Y.
examples: YES: 'Das ist kein Werkzeug, sondern ein Partner.'
NO: 'Der Export ist ein Werkzeug, das Dateien als Archiv ablegt.'

tell_filler.question: Does the section_text contain justifying filler (for example 'bewusst schlank', 'damit wir schnell lernen') or a vague mechanism phrase (for example 'spielt eine zentrale Rolle', 'kommt ins Spiel') instead of stating what is there?
tell_filler.rule: RULE tell_filler: Justifying filler ('bewusst schlank', 'damit wir schnell lernen') defends a state instead of describing it. A vague mechanism ('kommt ins Spiel', 'spielt eine zentrale Rolle') names no thing and place.
examples: YES: 'Heute bewusst schlank, damit wir schnell lernen.'
NO: 'Heute gibt es zwei Rollen; weitere folgen im Herbst.'

tell_closer.question: Does the section_text end a paragraph with a one-line closer that only repeats the paragraph as a lesson, or contain a staged opener ('Die Wahrheit ist', 'Here is the thing')?
tell_closer.rule: RULE tell_closer: A one-line closer repeats the paragraph as a lesson ('Der Hebel ist das Wissen.'). A staged opener ('Die Wahrheit ist', 'Here is the thing') delays the point. Cut both.
examples: YES: paragraph ends with 'Am Ende zählt das Vertrauen.'
NO: paragraph ends with the last concrete fact.
